evidence.claim: Rev +13% FX-neutral, op income +61%, op cash flow +29% LTM; negative FCF = datacenter growth capex
evidence.relation: growth capex converts to future cash flow

evidence.source: Adam Khoo — Highlight: SpaceX vs Amazon: Which Is Worth $2 Trillion? (2026-06-01)
evidence.claim: Khoo frames 'whole company' comparison: at ~$2T you get Amazon's $716B revenue and $146B profit (P/S ~3x, P/EBITDA ~16x) vs SpaceX $16B revenue/$8B EBITDA (P/S 109x, P/EBITDA 218x).
evidence.relation: Valuation contrast vs the hyped SpaceX IPO marks Amazon as comparatively cheap.
